name: Hearty Chicken Pot Pie
description: A comforting chicken pot pie filled with vegetables and chicken in a creamy sauce, topped with a pie crust.
recipeIngredient: 1 cup mixed vegetables (corn, carrots, leeks, mushrooms)
1 cup red wine or soya sauce

recipeInstructions.text: In a saucepan, simmer the mixed vegetables in chicken stock for 5 minutes.
In another saucepan, melt butter over medium heat. Stir in flour and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Whisk in milk and red wine (or soya sauce). Bring to a boil and thicken.
Add cooked chicken, tarragon, lemon rind, salt, and pepper to the sauce. Mix well.
Pour the filling into unbaked pie shells.
Cover with top crust and bake at 350°F for 1 hour.
Serve hot. Note that the filling freezes well for later use.

keywords: chicken pot pie, comfort food, savory pie

_similar.name: Turkey or Chicken Pies
_similar.description: Individual or large pies filled with turkey or chicken, vegetables, and a creamy sauce, topped with a homemade pastry crust or biscuits.
_similar.recipeYield: Multiple individual pies or 1 large pie

recipeInstructions.text: Melt margarine with salt and pepper over low heat. Add flour and gradually add broth, cooking until smooth.
Sauté chopped onion and celery until tender.
Boil carrots until thoroughly cooked.
Mix cooked carrots with peas and the sauce made earlier.
For the pastry, mix flour, salt, and baking powder with butter. Add milk to form a dough.
Fill small pans or a large pie plate with the turkey or chicken mixture and top with pastry crust or biscuits.
Bake until the crust is golden brown.

_similar.keywords: turkey pie, chicken pie, savory pastry, comfort food

_similar.name: Chicken with a Chinese Accent
_similar.description: A sweet and savory chicken dish with a Chinese-inspired flavor profile, featuring soya sauce and brown sugar.

recipeInstructions.text: Fry chicken breasts in a frying pan with oil and soya sauce until the outsides are done.
Transfer the chicken to a casserole dish.
Mix the remaining ingredients with soya sauce and pour over the chicken.
Bake for 35 minutes at 350°F.
Serve the chicken with rice.

_similar.keywords: Chinese chicken, sweet and savory, baked chicken

_similar.name: Chicken Hawaiian
recipeIngredient: 1 can (14 oz/398 mL) pineapple tidbits with juice

recipeInstructions.text: Combine rice, chicken broth, and contents of Bake 'N Shake pouch as directed on the package.
Arrange chicken breasts in a single layer in a 9x13 inch (2.5 L) casserole dish.
Coat chicken with a mixture of ground ginger and garlic.
Top chicken with pineapple tidbits and juice.
Sprinkle the prepared rice mixture over the chicken.
Bake uncovered at 375°F (180°C) for 30 minutes.

_similar.keywords: Hawaiian chicken, pineapple chicken, baked chicken and rice

_similar.name: Thai Chicken
_similar.description: A Thai-inspired chicken dish with spaghetti, vegetables, and a tangy sauce, served hot or chilled.
recipeIngredient: 2 tsp Sambal Oelek or hot pepper sauce

recipeInstructions.text: Cook pasta according to package directions for the minimum time. Drain, rinse with cold water, and drain again.
Stir pasta in a large bowl to coat with sesame oil.
Finely grate the peel from 1 lime and squeeze juice to measure 1/4 cup. Stir juice, peel, soya sauce, hot pepper sauce, salt, and sugar into pasta.
Slice chicken into bite-size pieces, thinly slice pepper, onion, and celery, and julienne carrots.
Stir-fry chicken in batches and return to the pan with garlic and onions. Stir-fry about 3 minutes.
Stir in water, peppers, celery, and carrots. Continue stirring about 3 minutes, adding a bit more water if necessary.
Add snow peas and stir about 1 minute.
Toss with the pasta, serve right away, or chill overnight and serve cold the next day.

_similar.name: Creamy Chicken Stew
_similar.description: A hearty and comforting chicken stew with vegetables in a creamy sauce.
recipeIngredient: 3 lb boneless, skinless chicken breasts, cut into 1-inch cubes

recipeInstructions.text: Heat oil in a Dutch oven. Sprinkle chicken with salt, pepper, and paprika. Cook and stir until the chicken is browned. Drain.
Add raw vegetables, basil, bay leaf, celery salt, and 5 cups broth; bring to a boil. Reduce heat. Cover and simmer for 30 minutes or until vegetables are tender.
Remove bay leaf. Add canned vegetables. Cook and stir for 2 minutes.
In a saucepan, mix flour and butter or margarine until smooth. Gradually whisk in remaining 2 cups broth. Bring to a boil. Cook and stir for 2 minutes or until thickened.
Pour the sauce into the Dutch oven. Stir and bring to a boil. Reduce heat. Simmer, uncovered, for 5 minutes.
Serve hot with rolls or biscuits.

_similar.keywords: chicken stew, creamy stew, comfort food
